basic_profile.bio: A 35-year-old former hockey player turned disc golf enthusiast. Living in Vancouver, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to hit the disc golf course during off-peak hours. I'm an avid Naruto fan and enjoy watching the series with my Golden Retriever, Max. I spend my evenings exploring new tech on my iPhone and occasionally dabble in DIY van conversion projects. I'm single and enjoy the freedom that comes with it, often spending weekends hiking or playing video games. Not a fan of overly aggressive online debates but enjoy friendly discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Grew up playing hockey from a young age, which has influenced my unique disc golf style. I have a degree in digital arts from Liberty University and have been self-teaching various design software over the years. My interest in technology and gadgets keeps me updated on the latest trends.
